test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mallika Sarabhai was honoured by the ____ government with Chevalier des Palmes Academiques 2005.
solution:
The correct answer is __**French**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mallika Sarabhai was honored by the French government with** Chevalier des Palmes Academiques 2005.**
 
• Mallika Sarabhai was the recipient of the **"French Palme D'or",** the **highest civilian award by the French Government**, and in Paris she was honored as the '**Best Soloist Artist**' among 400 dancers from 25 countries among other awards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mallika Sarabhai is born to** renowned Indian classical dancer Mrinalini Sarabhai and the legendary space scientist Vikram Sarabhai.**
 
• Mallika Sarabhai is an accomplished **Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam dancer** who has specialized in using the arts for social change and transformation.
 
• Dancer Mallika Sarabhai has turned out to be an **author with her memoir 'Free Fall: My Experiments with Living.'**
 
• The author described the book as one which helps anyone "come to terms with yourself, your body and finding the lifestyle that works for you."
 
• It also gives readers a peek into her **battles with grief and depression.**
